problems.gist: You get an m x n grid of characters board and a string word. Return true if the word can be spelled by a path of cells where each next cell is horizontally or vertically adjacent to the previous one, and no cell is used more than once. Otherwise return false.

cf.name: Petr and a Combination Lock
cf.why: enumerate all 2^n sign choices with a bitmask

problems.gist: A test engineer has a list nums of distinct integer option codes and wants to try every possible combination of options, including using none of them. Return all subsets of nums (the power set).

problems.title: Combination Sum
problems.gist: A shop sells parcels whose weights are given in an array candidates of distinct positive integers, and a customer wants a total weight of exactly target. You may take any parcel weight any number of times.

problems.title: Combination Sum II
problems.gist: You are given an array of positive integers candidates (values may repeat) and a positive integer target. Return every unique combination of candidates whose values sum to target. Each element of candidates may be used at most once in a combination.

problems.title: N-Queens
problems.gist: Given an integer n, place n queens on an n x n chessboard so that no two queens attack each other (no two share a row, a column or a diagonal). Return all distinct placements, in any order.

problems.title: Subsets II
problems.gist: You are given an integer array nums that may contain duplicate values. Return every possible subset (the power set), but without duplicate subsets: two subsets that hold the same values with the same multiplicities count as one.

problems.title: Palindrome Partitioning
problems.gist: You are given a string s. Split it into one or more contiguous pieces so that every piece is a palindrome (reads the same left to right and right to left). Return all such splits. Each split is a list of the pieces in order; the splits may be returned in any order.

problems.title: Word Search II
problems.gist: You are given an m x n grid board of lowercase letters and a list words of distinct strings. Return every word from the list that can be traced on the grid.

problems.title: Permutations
problems.gist: A race organiser has an array nums of distinct integer runner numbers and wants every possible finishing order. Return all permutations of nums: every ordering that uses each number exactly once. The orderings may be returned in any order.
